title: Morning outbound scramble — Tess
content:
Daily goal: 28 touches (calls + voicemails + emails) — focus: mid-market product analytics use cases.

Top priorities for today:
- Rebook demo with Amgen contact (urgent) — left voicemail 9/3, no response.
- Close commit with Nimbus (legal ready, waiting PO) — push to get signature by end of week.
- Re-engage EducateCo pilot champion (CxO escalation path).

Schedule / Call List (blocks + quick notes):
08:30 — 08:50: Prep / quick CRM tidy (update notes for yesterday)
09:00 — 09:10: Call: Amgen — Contact: Priya Shah (Director, Data Platforms) — CRM WD-4128 — note: left voicemail 9/3 pretending to be follow-up; strategy: short value hook + 2 available slots for week. If no answer, send one-line email + calendar invite with 2 options.
09:30 — 09:45: Warm intro follow-up: BlueHarbor — Contact: Marcus Li (ML Eng mgr) — talked 8/18; they wanted perf numbers on 8k token contexts. Action: send benchmark one-pager + ask about internal infra constraints.
10:00 — 10:20: Cold outreach attempt: AtlasRetail — Contact: SDR transfer (VM) — goal: get to AE discovery, leave note for SDR to warm intro if no answer.
10:30 — 10:40: Call: Nimbus Legal Ops — Contact: Sarah Choi — CRM WD-5199 — goal: confirm PO timeline, push to get final signature by Friday, escalate to AM if blocked.
11:00 — 11:20: Quick blitz: 5 voicemails (script below) + 2 follow-up emails queued.
13:30 — 13:50: Demo prep: EducateCo (internal sync with Mina) — finalize slide deck with new SLA slide.
14:00 — 14:30: Call: EducateCo champion — Contact: Andre Gomez — talk track: pilot results, propose exec briefing, prep next-step options.
15:00 — 15:20: Pipeline clean-up: mark stale opportunities older than 60 days for archival or revive sequence.
16:00 — 16:30: SDR packet review + handoffs for next week.

Call scripts / voice mail (short):
- VM script (10–12s): "Hi {name}, Tess Nguyen at Redwood Inference — quick note: we improved token-cost on 8k contexts by >30% for retailers. Calling to share a short benchmark and two times to chat — 415-555-01xx."
- Discovery openers: "What's your biggest pain with model cost/latency right now? Where does it surface (prod vs staging)?"

Follow-up email templates (snippets):
- After VM (one-liner): "Hi {name}, dropped a quick voicemail — attaching the 1-pager on our 8k-context benchmark. 2 slots: Tue 10am or Wed 2pm PT? — Tess"
- Post-demo next steps: "Thanks for your time — per our conversation, sharing the rollout checklist + SSO/KMS questionnaire. Can you share the final list of stakeholders for a pilot sign-off?"

Notes to self / reminders:
- Put Nimbus contract into close-watch; set reminder Fri AM if no PO.
- Ask Product for a short blurb about quantization gains (for BlueHarbor) — tag: @ravi.
- For EducateCo, ask Solutions to prep an exec one-pager (cost vs latency + compliance bullets).
- Track response times: if >48h, move to 'nudge' email sequence 2.

Pipeline quick triage (hot / warm / cold):
- Hot: Nimbus (legal PO), EducateCo (pilot exec ask), Amgen (director-level reschedule)
- Warm: BlueHarbor (benchmark interest), OrbitFleet (RFP in 30 days), AtlasRetail (SDR handoff pending)
- Cold: half-dozen entries older than 90 days — pick 3 to try one last re-engage.

Quick metrics (today):
- Daily target: 28 touches
- Actual by 16:30 target: 25+ touches (ok if demos/hand-offs take time)
- Conversion target this week: 2 demos booked -> 1 pilot commit

Unresolved questions / flags:
- Legal waiting on Nimbus redline: which clause is still in contention? Need ops to confirm.
- Amgen: are they evaluating multiple vendors? Need intel from Solutions.

After-call actions checklist (for each completed call):
- Log disposition in CRM (call, VM, interested, follow-up date)
- Send templated follow-up within 30 minutes
- Create task for solutions/engineering if ask > 2 hrs of prep

Reflection (end-of-day quick capture):
- What worked: 2 concise VMs got callbacks yesterday — keep VM script short
- What to change: block 90-min focused outbound time tomorrow (no meetings)

Random scratch / notes to self (brief):
- Try an A/B subject line for follow-up emails: "Short benchmark for {company}" vs "Question about {company}'s model costs"
- Ask ops for an up-to-date RTX pricing table for quick objections

End of morning pad. Update this after 16:30 with final counts + next-day plan.

-- Tess
